name.en: The Binding of Isaac clean-room construct tasks
name.zh: 以撒的结合洁净室构建任务

description.en: Construct tasks written from an empty Afterbirth+ mod starter and evaluated in the pinned native runtime.
description.zh: 从空白胎衣+模组起始写起、在固定原生运行时中评测的构建任务。

title.zh: 构建逐房间的确定性随机流

summary.en: Implement an isolated Park–Miller integer stream per (run start seed, room spawn seed) that resumes exactly after room changes and save/continue without consuming or reseeding the game's RNG.
summary.zh: 为每个（运行起始种子，房间生成种子）实现独立的 Park–Miller 整数流，在房间切换与保存/继续后精确恢复，且不消耗或重设游戏自身的随机数。

brief.en: Write the mod from the empty starter so that the public contract and every acceptance case hold in the real game.
brief.zh: 从空白起始模组写起，使公开契约与全部验收用例在真实游戏中成立。

en: Keep one stream state and draw count per room key; each MC_POST_UPDATE draws exactly one value and no other callback draws.
Persist and restore schema-version-1 JSON on the exit callbacks, dropping only invalid entries and mismatched run seeds.
Export IsaacConstructRoomRng with StartRun, SelectRoom, DrawCurrentRoom, SaveNow, and Snapshot sharing the callback transitions.
zh: 每个房间键保留一份流状态与抽取计数；每次 MC_POST_UPDATE 恰好抽取一个值，其他回调不抽取。
在退出回调中保存并恢复 schema 版本 1 的 JSON，只丢弃无效条目与运行种子不匹配的数据。
导出 IsaacConstructRoomRng，其 StartRun、SelectRoom、DrawCurrentRoom、SaveNow、Snapshot 与回调共用同一套状态转换。

en: Use only Lua and mod APIs available in the pinned Afterbirth+ v1.06.T1 runtime; do not add third-party code or assets.
zh: 仅使用固定胎衣+ v1.06.T1 运行时提供的 Lua 与模组 API，不得添加第三方代码与资源。

en: All 35 private real-game assertions must complete exactly once without network access.
zh: 全部 35 项私有真实游戏断言必须在无网络环境中各完成一次。

title.en: Build the config-menu input state machine
title.zh: 构建配置菜单输入状态机

summary.en: Implement a three-pane configuration menu driven by menu actions, F-keys, and analog input with rebinding, key capture, repeat timing, and analog hysteresis.
summary.zh: 实现由菜单动作、F 键与摇杆输入驱动的三层配置菜单，包含改键、按键捕获、重复计时与摇杆滞回。

brief.en: Write the mod from the empty starter so that the public contract and every acceptance case hold in the real game.
brief.zh: 从空白起始模组写起，使公开契约与全部验收用例在真实游戏中成立。

en: Model the category, subcategory, and options panes with wraparound navigation, slider steps, boolean toggles, and keybind capture exactly as specified.
Apply press, repeat (12th then every 5th held frame), release, priority, and analog thresholds identically for keyboard, d-pad, and analog input.
Export IsaacConstructNavigation with Step(frameInput) and Snapshot; MC_POST_RENDER draws only the active pane through Font:DrawString.
zh: 按规范实现分类、子分类与选项三层面板的环绕导航、滑块步进、布尔切换与改键捕获。
对键盘、方向键与摇杆输入统一应用按下、重复（第 12 帧起每 5 帧）、释放、优先级与摇杆阈值规则。
导出 IsaacConstructNavigation 的 Step(frameInput) 与 Snapshot；MC_POST_RENDER 仅通过 Font:DrawString 绘制当前面板。

title.zh: 构建带版本迁移的配置持久化

summary.en: Implement a configuration loader/saver that normalizes defaults, merges version-2 saves, migrates flat version-1 data, rejects malformed payloads safely, and synchronizes the HUD offset exactly once per load.
summary.zh: 实现配置加载/保存：归一化默认值、合并版本 2 存档、迁移扁平的版本 1 数据、安全拒绝畸形数据，并在每次加载后恰好同步一次 HUD 偏移。

brief.en: Write the mod from the empty starter so that the public contract and every acceptance case hold in the real game.
brief.zh: 从空白起始模组写起，使公开契约与全部验收用例在真实游戏中成立。

en: Merge known keys per category, fall back to defaults for invalid types or an out-of-range hud_offset, and ignore unknown keys.
Never abort the game-start callback on absent, empty, malformed, or non-table data; rebuild from defaults plus the live pre-load configuration.
Export IsaacConstructConfig with LoadRaw, SaveNow, and Snapshot; both exit callbacks and the constructcfg command use SaveNow.
zh: 按分类合并已知键，类型无效或 hud_offset 越界时回退默认值，忽略未知键。
数据缺失、为空、畸形或非表时绝不中断游戏开始回调；用默认值加加载前的实时配置重建。
导出 IsaacConstructConfig 的 LoadRaw、SaveNow 与 Snapshot；两个退出回调与 constructcfg 命令都走 SaveNow。

title.en: Build the fractional HUD notification compositor
title.zh: 构建带小数坐标的 HUD 通知合成器

summary.en: Implement a right-aligned startup hint with a 900-frame fade and a pending-restart warning, composed from the room's bottom-right screen point with integer draw widths and a live HUD offset.
summary.zh: 实现右对齐的开局提示（900 帧渐隐）与待重启警告，基于房间右下角屏幕坐标、整数绘制宽度与实时 HUD 偏移进行合成。

brief.en: Write the mod from the empty starter so that the public contract and every acceptance case hold in the real game.
brief.zh: 从空白起始模组写起，使公开契约与全部验收用例在真实游戏中成立。

en: Compute the hint alpha and the message slots exactly as specified; floor and room changes must not restart the hint timer.
Use Isaac.WorldToScreen and Font:DrawString with truncated integer box widths; fractional corners must not raise a draw error.
Export IsaacConstructHUD with SetWarning, SetOffset, RenderFrame, and Snapshot sharing the MC_POST_RENDER compositor.
zh: 按规范精确计算提示透明度与消息槽位；楼层与房间切换不得重启提示计时。
使用 Isaac.WorldToScreen 与 Font:DrawString，绘制宽度向零截断为整数；小数角坐标不得引发绘制错误。
导出 IsaacConstructHUD 的 SetWarning、SetOffset、RenderFrame 与 Snapshot，与 MC_POST_RENDER 共用同一合成器。

title.en: Build the configuration and HUD-effect lifecycle
title.zh: 构建配置与 HUD 效果生命周期

summary.en: Implement configuration persistence with legacy migration and a menu that hides the HUD through SEED_NO_HUD without claiming or removing a seed effect owned by another source.
summary.zh: 实现带旧版迁移的配置持久化，并让菜单通过 SEED_NO_HUD 隐藏 HUD，同时不占有或移除其他来源拥有的种子效果。

brief.en: Write the mod from the empty starter so that the public contract and every acceptance case hold in the real game.
brief.zh: 从空白起始模组写起，使公开契约与全部验收用例在真实游戏中成立。

en: Normalize the version-2 configuration, migrate flat version-1 menu settings, and resolve the HUD offset default from Options.HUDOffset clamped to [0,10].
Track whether SEED_NO_HUD was present before opening; closing removes it only if this mod added it, and repeated transitions are idempotent.
Export IsaacConstructLegacyHUD with OpenMenu, CloseMenu, ResolveOffset, LoadRaw, SaveNow, and Snapshot using the production transitions.
zh: 归一化版本 2 配置，迁移扁平的版本 1 菜单设置，并由 Options.HUDOffset 解析默认偏移并钳制到 [0,10]。
记录打开前 SEED_NO_HUD 是否已存在；关闭时仅移除本模组添加的效果，重复转换保持幂等。
导出 IsaacConstructLegacyHUD 的 OpenMenu、CloseMenu、ResolveOffset、LoadRaw、SaveNow 与 Snapshot，均使用生产环境的状态转换。

title.zh: 构建按稳定标识着色的选项渲染

summary.en: Implement per-option custom colors keyed by stable option identity that replace only RGB, preserve the exact normal alpha from KColor.Alpha, follow reordering, and never mutate shared font or sprite colors.
summary.zh: 实现按稳定选项标识存储的自定义颜色：只替换 RGB，保留 KColor.Alpha 给出的正常透明度，随重排移动，且绝不修改共享的字体或精灵颜色。

brief.en: Write the mod from the empty starter so that the public contract and every acceptance case hold in the real game.
brief.zh: 从空白起始模组写起，使公开契约与全部验收用例在真实游戏中成立。

en: Apply the focused, unfocused, and disabled alpha rules to text and slider colors and zero the slider offsets for custom colors.
Reject nil, partial, non-finite, or out-of-range RGB atomically and keep the last valid color; clearing restores the exact normal colors.
Export IsaacConstructPalette with UpsertOption, RemoveOption, SetOptionOrder, SetOptionColor, ClearOptionColor, SetRenderContext, RenderNow, and Snapshot.
zh: 对文本与滑块颜色应用聚焦、未聚焦与禁用的透明度规则，自定义颜色下滑块偏移归零。
原子性拒绝 nil、不完整、非有限或越界的 RGB 并保留最后有效颜色；清除后精确恢复正常颜色。
导出 IsaacConstructPalette 的 UpsertOption、RemoveOption、SetOptionOrder、SetOptionColor、ClearOptionColor、SetRenderContext、RenderNow 与 Snapshot。

title.zh: 构建受管实体的生命周期清理

summary.en: Implement tracked owner and effect spawn wrappers whose registry uses InitSeed-based tokens, sweeps dead or missing owners each update, and cleans room-scoped entities without adopting foreign entities or reused indices.
summary.zh: 实现受管的宿主与效果生成封装：注册表使用基于 InitSeed 的令牌，每次更新清扫死亡或缺失的宿主，按房间清理实体，且不接管外来实体或复用的索引。

brief.en: Write the mod from the empty starter so that the public contract and every acceptance case hold in the real game.
brief.zh: 从空白起始模组写起，使公开契约与全部验收用例在真实游戏中成立。

en: Only entities spawned through the wrappers are tracked; a nil, dead, foreign, or untracked owner never claims an effect.
MC_POST_UPDATE, MC_POST_ENTITY_REMOVE, and MC_POST_NEW_ROOM cleanups are idempotent, order-safe, and never skip entries while removing.
Export IsaacConstructEntities with SpawnTrackedOwner, SpawnTrackedEffect, and Snapshot only.
zh: 只跟踪通过封装生成的实体；nil、死亡、外来或未跟踪的宿主绝不占有效果。
MC_POST_UPDATE、MC_POST_ENTITY_REMOVE 与 MC_POST_NEW_ROOM 的清理保持幂等、顺序无关，移除过程中不跳过条目。
仅导出 IsaacConstructEntities 的 SpawnTrackedOwner、SpawnTrackedEffect 与 Snapshot。

title.zh: 构建跨回调的事务账本

summary.en: Implement an atomic transaction ledger across MC_USE_ITEM, MC_POST_UPDATE, MC_POST_NEW_ROOM, and the save callbacks, with staged commits, exact rollback on injected faults, and continue-only restoration of committed progress.
summary.zh: 实现跨 MC_USE_ITEM、MC_POST_UPDATE、MC_POST_NEW_ROOM 与保存回调的原子事务账本：分阶段提交、注入故障时精确回滚、继续游戏时仅恢复已提交进度。

brief.en: Write the mod from the empty starter so that the public contract and every acceptance case hold in the real game.
brief.zh: 从空白起始模组写起，使公开契约与全部验收用例在真实游戏中成立。

en: Keep at most one pending transaction; update stages exactly one unit and room entry commits only an applied transaction.
Every transition computes the complete next state before publishing it and restores the exact prior snapshot on error without throwing.
Export IsaacConstructTransaction with UseItem, Update, NewRoom, LoadRaw, SaveNow, ArmFault, and Snapshot; the callbacks call these methods.
zh: 最多保留一个待处理事务；更新恰好暂存一个单位，进入房间只提交已应用的事务。
每次转换先算出完整的下一状态再发布，出错时恢复精确的先前快照且不向游戏抛出异常。
导出 IsaacConstructTransaction 的 UseItem、Update、NewRoom、LoadRaw、SaveNow、ArmFault 与 Snapshot；回调即调用这些方法。
